title: Origin story: Mothwing
description: Mothwing was a gardener's child who preferred the night shift, when the moths did the pollinating. She learned their dust-language and became their keeper, and now the night gardens bloom by her tending — moonflowers, night jasmine, and the silver trees that only grow where moths have blessed the soil.

description: Ranked abilities: Moth-tongue — rank 100/100; Night gardening — rank 99/100; Gentleness — rank 98/100; Patience — rank 97/100; Botany — rank 95/100.

description: Powers: Moths obey her as their keeper; Night-blooming plants answer her call; Her dust heals blighted soil.

title: Stamina feats: Mothwing
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Tended the gardens every night for decades; Waited out the blight without despair.
